finance_title: Auto Financial System — AI-Powered Expense Tracking & Financial Dashboard
finance_description: A personal financial management system combining ChatGPT-assisted receipt processing, automated expense logging in Google Sheets, and an interactive financial dashboard.
finance_overview: Auto Financial System connects AI-assisted receipt information extraction with automated expense recording and financial visualization. It brings transaction categorization, expense management, and spending analysis into a workflow built around Google Sheets and Google Apps Script.
finance_receipts: AI-assisted receipt processing: use ChatGPT to extract receipt information for expense tracking.
finance_logging: Automated expense logging: record expenses in Google Sheets and organize transactions by category.
finance_monthly: Monthly summaries: review spending totals and compare expenses across months.
finance_dashboard: Interactive dashboard: explore financial charts, spending trends, and category breakdowns.
finance_stores: Store analysis: review spending by store to better understand purchasing patterns.
finance_pipeline: Data workflow: ChatGPT assists with receipt information extraction, Google Sheets records expense data, and Google Apps Script supports automated data processing.
finance_frontend: Dashboard: JavaScript, HTML, and CSS provide the interface for interactive financial visualization, monthly comparisons, category breakdowns, and store analysis.
finance_demo_description: Watch the Auto Financial System demonstration to explore its AI-assisted expense tracking and financial dashboard.
